def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    credit_sales = 40000
    cogs = 30000
    accounts_receivable = 3000
    beginning_inventory = 1500
    ending_inventory = 2000
    accounts_payable = 4000
    period_days = 365

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    average_inventory = (beginning_inventory + ending_inventory) / 2
    dio = (average_inventory / cogs) * period_days
    dso = (accounts_receivable / credit_sales) * period_days
    dpo = (accounts_payable / cogs) * period_days

    cash_conversion_cycle = dio + dso - dpo
    answer = round(cash_conversion_cycle, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
